series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames of Batch 032 approved, uploaded to Drive and MD5-verified against Drive's own checksum. The batch covers the bones fused into black glass and the debut of DRG-VAL-001, and it took 21 generations to reach ten approvals. The last two frames were the hard ones: 0316 needed six passes before the animal read as a reptile at cinema scale, and 0320 was regenerated after its approved file was lost in a sandbox reset before upload. Episode progress advances to 326/1,050 (31.05%).
letterbox_scan_note: Per-row edge-mean scan run on every frame before approval. Letterbox strips were found and cropped on 0313 (content rows 12-755), 0315 (12-755, cropped after its rerender), 0319 (12-755) and 0318 (44-675), each then resized to 1376x768. All ten delivered frames are full-bleed 1376x768 with no black bars.
dragon_reveal_note: DRG-VAL-001 debuts here and is given first as monumental fragments rather than a full reveal: out-of-frame wing-shoulder with the neck running off the top edge (0316), through a column gap (0317), as a silhouette in an ember-lit chamber (0318), ultra-wide at the limit of legibility (0319), and a closer read in 0320 while the animal is above frame and the boy turns away. Never centred on a complete pose, never facing camera, never breathing fire in this batch. 0316 is the batch's establishing dragon image: the neck terminates above the frame, which is both a scale device and the fix for a recurring failure in which any closed off-frame mass resolved as a head.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Vitrified black wall with ribs and horned sheep skull fused into the glass, herdsman tiny at base, back to camera. No snow, no masonry. Letterbox scan clean.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Macro ribs in black glass, meniscus reading bright on one edge, no flesh/blood. Letterbox scan clean.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved after letterbox reframe (content rows 12-755 cropped and resized). Strict profile, no eye visible, hair #EFE8D8 with two narrow temple braids only. Letterbox scan clean after fix.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Macro horned skull half-dissolved into melt, no gore. No people in frame as specified.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved on pass 3, then letterbox-reframed (content rows 12-755). Bones now genuinely EMBEDDED under a hard black glass casing with the upper halves swallowed, not resting on top; ground matte black to every edge; elder in a mid-thigh cloak with trousers and boots visible and a fully haired crown. Drive copy replaced after the reframe so the uploaded MD5 matches the cropped file.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED on the seventh generation. Low angle: the dragon fills the upper right, its neck rising up and out of the top edge so the mass has no terminus; one folded wing sweeps down across the middle as a taut leathery membrane with ragged scalloped margins and long straight rib-spars; a blunt-clawed forefoot rests on black rock at lower right. Two rear-view figures at lower left. Reptilian hide throughout, no feathers, no beak, no head, eye or jaw anywhere in frame, no fire. Ground and walls stay black to the corners. This pass abandoned the strategy of negating bird anatomy and instead removed the head from frame entirely.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: Approved on pass 3. Fully interior: no sky, no daylight, no green hills; ledge is raw fractured basalt, not coursed masonry; no flame of any kind. Long crocodilian skull, twin obsidian horns, one folded wing, four limbs. Pass 2 had produced a literal column of fire behind the animal, which is a hard fail.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: Approved after letterbox reframe (content rows 44-675 cropped and resized). Coiled dragon silhouette, strictly four limbs, no humans, at limit of legibility. Letterbox scan clean after fix.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: Approved on pass 2 after letterbox reframe (content rows 12-755). Crowd genuinely scattered at six different distances and postures with no line-up; floor carries only thin dull ember cracks, no molten channel; dragon on a shattered tilted slab rather than a squared block. The pale columnar rock of the ledge is natural jointing, not masonry.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED on the second generation after the first approved file was lost in a sandbox reset. MCU 50mm: the boy behind a black wet rock lip, three-quarter turned away, eyes fixed off-frame with no lens contact, pale silver-white shoulder-length hair with a single temple braid, basalt soot on cheek and neck, brown leather jerkin and ash-grey tunic, warm ember rim on the hair. Full-bleed 1376x768.

upload_note: Ten approved frames uploaded to the batch folder and MD5-verified against Drive. A duplicate upload of 0315, a pre-reframe 0315 and a premature 0316 were moved to trash after replacement. Final checksum comparison returned ten files, ten exact matches.
